resolved_returns.name: resolved_returns
resolved_returns.description: Returns resolved for one store in a window

definition.formula: COUNT_IF(CASE WHEN ((NOT m.SR_RESOLVED_AT IS NULL OR LOWER(m.SR_RETURN_STATUS) IN ('resolved', 'closed'))) AND (COALESCE(m.SR_RESOLVED_AT, m.SR_RETURNED_DATE) >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) THEN (NOT m.SR_RESOLVED_AT IS NULL OR LOWER(m.SR_RETURN_STATUS) IN ('resolved', 'closed')) END)

dimensions.name: store
dimensions.description: The store the return is attributed to.

examples.question: How many returns did store 42 resolve in the last 30 days?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_RETURNS WHERE SR_STORE_SK = 42 AND SR_RESOLVED_AT >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

definition.population: Returns that reached a resolved or closed state
